audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Vayne wins all seven stages on both layers (content win[0..6] all 'Vayne'; full phases[0..4].side 'Vayne' at 2/10-3/10). The packet chart is Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Vayne, Vayne, Garen's win rate is 54.33% over 4395 games, and whys[0..4] and the early/mid prose all say Garen bullies her before items. Difficulty is also stamped 8/10 while diff is 'FAV'.
audit.why: Every other data source in the brief says Garen owns levels 1-5 and loses only after Vayne's item spikes. The chart is inverted for the first five rows and the difficulty rating contradicts both the win rate and the diff token.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flip to Garen (7/10 to 7.5/10); rows 6-7 stay Vayne, which already matches. diffRating goes 8/10 -> 4/10 and the difficulty prose is restated as a favourable lane with a high carry threat.

audit.why: The four spikes are correctly placed: Garen at levels 3-5, still ahead at 6 (Final Hour grants AD, Tumble stealth and cooldown reduction, and bonus move speed — no burst), inverting at her first item plus Blade of the Ruined King, and lost late. spikes[3].when 'Late' matches the chart's 2+ items row.
audit.corrected: Kept the spike structure; only sharpened spikes[0] with Tumble's real 6s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] gives Condemn as '(18s)', and no page states that Tumble is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12 — 20s at rank 1, which is the lane-relevant number. Tumble carries the autoReset flag and Riot's text ('Her next attack deals bonus damage'), so her burst opens on an attack wind-up, not a visible cast. That is flagged in missingInteractions for this exact matchup. Condemn is also a projectile with knockup plus a terrain stun, so open ground is materially safer than fighting against a wall.
audit.corrected: Quote 20s at rank 1, say the knockback stuns only on terrain, and name Tumble's reset as the tell to step back.

edits.before: Track Vayne’s Condemn (18s): Wall-stun. Position so she can’t pin you. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1: it knocks you back, and stuns only on terrain. Fight in open ground, step in on its downtime.

edits.before: Get condemned into a wall. Chase her tumbles blindly. Let her free-farm to 2 items. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.
edits.after: Get condemned into a wall. Chase her tumbles blindly — Tumble is an auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue to back off. Let her free-farm to 2 items.
